answer: By binding each agent to a scarce stake and a deterministic fault-tree audit, an economy can treat a sybil cluster as gale stressing a garden: one sparrow-sized anomaly triggers containment before propagation. Colluding identities must post independent collateral verified through probabilistic risk assessment, so forged keys inherit correlated failure modes that audit exposes. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
